messages:
Alex: Short proposal 3 actionability hint in error responses so SDKs + console behave the same.
Alex: Key: an 'actionability' token plus optional 'console_hint' in body/headers. Makes console CTA deterministic and lets SDKs implement polite defaults.
Priya: Outline the HTTP mapping we'll use.
Alex: Mapping: 429 -> rate_limited (actionability=retry), include Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Detail. 402 -> billing_required (actionability=purchase) with invoice_id + console_link. 451 -> legal_restriction (actionability=appeal) with appeal_link. 503 -> service_congested (actionability=retry_with_backoff) with X-Suggested-Backoff. 409 -> client_conflict (actionability=patch_client) with expected_version.
Jonah: Using 402 for billing is explicit and lets console show pay flow inline. Good.
Mei: Telemetry: tag errors with error_class and actionability. Metrics: api.errors.count{error_class="billing|rate_limit|congestion|compliance|conflict", actionability="retry|purchase|appeal|patch"}. Also track sdk.retry_invocations and console.hint_clicks.
Alex: Console UX: purchase -> show inline payment CTA; appeal -> show legal form; retry hints -> suggest backoff tips. Badge colors keep info/warn/blocked semantics.
Priya: SDK plan: read actionability first, fall back to status codes if missing. Provide opt-out flag.
Jonah: Rollout: feature-flagged, canary 3% for 1h. KPIs: unexpected_client_retries, console_assist_click_rate, billing_flow_success_rate. Abort if unexpected_client_retries > 40% or billing_flow_success drops.
Mei: Alert: if sdk.retry_invocations spikes but api.success_rate doesn't improve -> futile retries.
deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled 2026-04-02T09:00Z -> 3% for 1h. Link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/rollouts/3098760000
Alex: Action items: Priya: SDK PR to honor actionability; Jonah: console CTA mockups; Mei: dashboards + alerts; Alex: changelog + integrator note.
Priya: Will start PR and include migration guide.
Jonah: Pairing with support for messaging templates on 402/451.
Mei: Adding dashboard panels and an alert on futile retries.
Alex: Proceeding if no objections. :thumbsup:
